<p><strong>Jiří Rytina and Adam Dittrich</strong><br/>

<section class="ac-item-body" id="measuring-financial-stress-under-the-gold-standard-evidence-from-interwar-czechoslovakia">
<h3>Measuring Financial Stress under the Gold Standard: Evidence from Interwar Czechoslovakia</h3>
<p><strong>Adam Dittrich</strong></p>
<p>A monthly composite index uses eleven financial and macro-financial indicators to recover the chronology of pressure from November 1929 to September 1938. The project connects statistical measurement to the institutional mechanics of the Czechoslovak gold-standard regime.</p>
<p><a class="pill-link" href="https://www.openicpsr.org/openicpsr/project/247312/version/V1/view">Data and documentation</a> <a class="pill-link" href="data.html#financial-stress-under-the-gold-standard">Project summary</a></p>
</section>
